scene: The bronze heron clicks open its chest hatch, revealing a brass dial.
picture: A first-person close view of the mechanical heron's polished bronze torso. In the centre, an open compartment reveals intricate ticking clockwork and a notched brass dial. On the left, a loose silver feather sticks out under its wing joint. On the right, a tiny keyhole glows with green phosphorescent light.
shown: a notched brass winding dial set in the bird's open chest at centre
a loose silver quill feather wedged beneath the bird's wing on the left
